decks.notes: The main concept of this goblin aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with a swarm of aggressive goblin creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Goblin Bushwhacker, Reckless Bushwhacker, and Kuldotha Rebirth, you can flood the board with small creatures and then use cards like Goblin Grenade and Gleeful Demolition to finish off your opponent. Additionally, cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Voldaren Epicure provide additional damage and card advantage, while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Manamorphose help to maintain momentum and consistency in the deck.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient white creatures. The deck aims to quickly build a wide board presence and utilize cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar to buff the team and create big threats. Additionally, the deck has a strong disruptive element with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Esper Sentinel, making it difficult for the opponent to execute their game plan effectively. The deck also incorporates some protection and card advantage with Ranger-Captain of Eos and Horizon Canopy.

The deck revolves around using cycling creatures and spells to fill up the graveyard quickly, then casting Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield all at once. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden swarm of powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan with control elements like Force of Negation. The deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn, making it a high-risk, high-reward strategy that requires careful timing and resource management.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Urza's Saga to assemble a combo that allows the player to repeatedly cast spells from their graveyard, generating value and potentially winning the game on the spot. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble are used to cycle through the deck and find key pieces of the combo, while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer helps generate mana and card advantage. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful synergies.

This deck aims to control the game by using counterspells and removal spells while assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana. The key concept is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Karn, the Great Creator, while ultimately winning the game with powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The deck also includes versatile cards like Engineered Explosives and Academy Ruins to handle various situations.

This deck focuses on quickly casting powerful spells with Cascade, allowing you to swarm the board with impactful creatures and disrupt your opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, you can cascade into high-impact cards like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a flurry of creatures and spells while maintaining control through counterspells and removal. The combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells make this deck a force to be reckoned with in the Modern format.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on using efficient creatures like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Terminate, to apply early pressure on the opponent. The deck also utilizes powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate additional value and threats. By combining aggression with disruption and card advantage, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to equip a creature with Colossus Hammer and attack for lethal damage in a single turn. This deck utilizes equipment support cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Sigarda's Aid to efficiently get the necessary pieces in play. The deck also features ways to protect the equipped creature, such as Giver of Runes and Solitude, to ensure the combo goes off successfully. Overall, it aims to win the game through a powerful and explosive combo strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures while disrupting the opponent with counterspells and hand disruption. By using cards like Architects of Will, Shardless Agent, and Street Wraith to cycle through the deck, the player can set up for a big Living End play, bringing back all the creatures from the graveyard to overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to win through this explosive combo and control the game with its disruptive elements to ensure the Living End resolves successfully.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a high tempo strategy focused on casting powerful cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent. By using these spells to cheat out powerful threats like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent, the deck can quickly put pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Force of Negation helps to protect the deck's key threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan, allowing it to efficiently execute its aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to exchange a player's non-land cards for tokens of a chosen creature type. By combining this with cards like Archon of Cruelty and Leyline Binding, the deck aims to create a powerful board presence quickly and disrupt opponent strategies. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce helps to protect the combo pieces and ensure its success. The creative use of these cards allows the player to have control over the battlefield and dictate the flow of the game.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly to cast powerful colorless spells. It utilizes cards like Ancient Stirrings, Sylvan Scrying, and Expedition Map to search for the Tron lands efficiently. The deck includes powerful threats like Karn Liberated, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the board and win the game. It also includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Blast Zone for additional control and disruption, making it difficult for opponents to build and maintain their board presence.
